title: Call Centre Advisor
description:
Call Centre Advisor

Glasgow

6 Month Contract Start Date: 9th November

Monday to Friday, 10:30am to 7:00pm

157 per day via Umbrella

Tate are delighted to be working with a leading retail and commercial bank to recruit a number of Call Centre Advisors to join their Fraud and Scams team. These opportunities are ideal for experienced Customer Service Advisors and Contact Centre professionals who are passionate about supporting customers and making a difference during challenging situations.

These roles play a vital part in helping customers affected by the increasing threat of fraud and scams, ensuring they receive the support, guidance and protection they need when they need it most.

Our client is offering the opportunity to join their business on a 6-month contract. If you have experience working in a call centre, contact centre or financial services environment and enjoy supporting customers with empathy, patience and understanding, we would love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

As a Fraud Advisor, you will support customers who have unfortunately fallen victim to fraud or scams. Working within a busy banking contact centre environment, you will speak with customers every day, helping them navigate difficult situations and providing reassurance throughout the process.

Full training will be provided to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to investigate concerns, support vulnerable customers and secure positive outcomes.

Key Details
- 157 per day, paid via an Umbrella company
- 6 month contract
- Training will be fully office based for up to 6 weeks
- Training hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
- Hybrid working after training, with 3 days per week in the office
- Glasgow City Centre location
- Working hours of 10:30am to 7:00pm, Monday to Friday
- Start date: 9th November

What You'll Be Doing
- Working in a fast-paced call centre environment, taking up to 60 calls per day.
- Supporting banking customers during vulnerable moments and helping them resolve fraud and scam related concerns.
- Building natural rapport through high quality conversations, ensuring customers feel protected, supported and valued.
- Demonstrating resilience when handling challenging customer situations and delivering positive outcomes.
- Delivering an exceptional customer experience, tailoring your approach to each individual's needs.
- Showing empathy, patience and understanding throughout difficult conversations.
- Learning about emerging fraud trends and scam activity to continually develop your knowledge and expertise.
- Working closely with colleagues to share best practice and contribute to team success.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within a contact centre or call centre environment.
- Experience within Financial Services or Banking is highly desirable.
- Comfortable managing a high volume of customer calls, typically 60+ per day.
- Excellent listening, communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to demonstrate empathy and understanding during sensitive customer conversations.
- Strong team working skills and a highly motivated attitude.
- A genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer service.
- Flexible and adaptable approach to changing business priorities.
- Ability to learn quickly and develop within a specialist fraud and scams environment.

Training

Successful candidates will complete up to 6 weeks of paid training. At least 4 weeks of the training programme will be delivered onsite in the office, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm.

Once training has been successfully completed, the role will move to a hybrid working pattern with office attendance required 3 days per week.

Please Note

This position is within the Financial Services sector and will be subject to comprehensive pre-employment screening, including a DBS check, credit check and three years' referencing.

Please also note that this role will be paid via an Umbrella company. We recommend that applicants understand how Umbrella payment arrangements operate and consider this before applying.

What's Next?

If you're interested in joining a leading bank as a Fraud Advisor, Customer Service Advisor or Call Centre Advisor, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and, if your application is suitable, a member of our team will be in touch to discuss the opportunity further.

Please note that the start date for this role is Monday 9th November.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Call Centre Operator
description:
Start date: 30.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

About this role

Every successful shift starts with the right people turning up on time, ready to work. As our Recruitment Account Coordinator, you'll be responsible for resourcing quality candidates and managing the requirements of our industrial clients. It's a busy desk, with a clear route into an Account Manager role when you're ready for the next step.

Search is a leading multi-discipline recruitment agency, backed by private equity and on an ambitious growth trajectory across our 13 specialisms and offices UK-wide. You'll be joining our record-breaking Industrial team in Glasgow, working on a well-established desk that's already generating revenue, meaning the ability to earn bonus from day 1!

Whether you already have recruitment or account management experience, or you're looking to build a successful career in the recruitment industry, this is exactly the platform to do it. If you thrive working at pace, and want a clear path to your next promotion, we'd like to hear from you.

Why join us?
- Join a record-breaking team on a warm, established desk, with bonus opportunities from day one.
- Focus on what you do best, resourcing quality candidates and managing client requirements, rather than business development.
- Real progression, with the opportunity to step up into an Account Manager role.
- Grow your career with a clear development plan, backed by award-winning training and 1:1 coaching from our dedicated Talent Development team.
- Join a down-to-earth, driven team that celebrates success, from regular social events and early finishes to our annual European getaway for top performers.

What you'll be doing
- Resourcing quality candidates for temporary and permanent industrial vacancies; sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
- Manage the requirements of our key clients, understanding their staffing needs and providing recruitment solutions.
- Manage the recruitment process from application through to placement.
- Coordinate candidate onboarding, compliance checks, and registrations.
- Schedule shift rotas and manage workforce bookings to meet client requirements.
- Monitor attendance and manage absence reporting.
- Visit client sites when required to run inductions and support new starters.
- Keep all candidate records and compliance documentation accurate and up to date.
- Deliver excellent service to candidates and clients, every time.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within recruitment or account management, or a genuine drive to build a successful career in the recruitment industry.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to work at pace while keeping accuracy and attention to detail high.
- Excellent organisational skills.
- The ability to build strong, long-lasting relationships with clients and candidates.
- A resilient, hardworking attitude with a real commitment to delivering results.

How you'll benefit
- A lucrative bonus structure that rewards your performance.

- Full back-office and marketing support, so you can focus on what you do best.
- Comprehensive, ongoing training and development from our award-winning Talent Development team.
- Option to buy or sell holidays via salary sacrifice.
- Quarterly and Annual HighFlyers events, plus our annual European getaway for top performers.
